title: About CATER
text: Founded by Jeff Buckley, PhD, CATER (Center for the Advancement of Technology Education Research) is a collaborative community dedicated to understanding how digital tools can transform pedagogical landscapes. Our center operates at the intersection of data science, psychological measurement, and practical classroom implementation.

title: About CATER
text:
Core Agendas & Activities
We are committed to three pillars of action:




 #### Infrastructure Development Developing robust, reliable research tools, unique methodologies, and validated scales for assessing technology efficacy in diverse educational settings.




 #### Translation for the Public Translating complex, evidence-based findings into accessible insights for educators, parents, and policymakers. (Detailed content to follow).




 #### Research Accelerator Fostering a unique environment of mutual support, inspired by models like the Psychological Science Accelerator, where members collaborate on large-scale data collection, peer review, and statistical analysis.
